# About Us

## We’re building for a world where infrastructure isn't just automated—it’s accessible, intelligent, and shared.

## Who We Are

We empower organizations to effortlessly articulate and achieve infrastructure goals through automation. By redefining enterprise infrastructure management, we are changing how enterprises compose, deploy, and manage infrastructure, dramatically reducing operational complexity while ensuring strict compliance and full visibility at scale.

Our mission is to set a new standard for infrastructure automation, making it accessible, understandable and powerful. By focusing on bridging human intent and infrastructure outcomes through AI, Spacelift is redefining enterprise infrastructure automation.

## What We Do

The Spacelift Infrastructure Orchestration Platform delivers compliance, control, and rapid scalability by managing the entire infrastructure lifecycle – provisioning, configuration and governance. Spacelift integrates with existing infrastructure tooling (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible) to provide a single integrated workflow to deliver secure, cost-effective and resilient infrastructure, fast.

By automating deployment and configuration, providing developer self-service, golden paths with guardrails and an OPA policy engine, Spacelift empowers businesses to accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control and governance over their infrastructure.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- What is Spacelift, and how does it work?





Spacelift is an infrastructure-as-code (IaC) orchestration platform that automates plans, applies, policy checks, and drift detection while keeping full auditability. You connect your VCS repo and point Spacelift at your IaC directory; Spacelift then runs workflows across any cloud and records every action for governance and security.

- What makes Spacelift different from other IaC management platforms?





Spacelift stands out for its flexibility, security, and deep customization capabilities.



  - **Multi-IaC support:** One platform for Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Kubernetes, CloudFormation, and Ansible.
  - **Built-in governance:** Policy-as-code with OPA for automated security, compliance, and guardrails at scale.
  - **Faster delivery with control:** Self-service infrastructure that boosts developer velocity without sacrificing oversight.
  - **Stay in desired state:** Drift detection and remediation reduce risk from configuration drift.
  - **Enterprise at the core:** RBAC, SSO/SAML, audit logs, Stack/Space isolation, and reusable modules.
  - **No lock-in:** Deep customization and seamless integrations with your existing DevOps toolchain.

- Which technologies and tools does Spacelift support?





Spacelift is multi-cloud and hybrid-friendly, integrating with:



  - **IaC and DevOps tools:** Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, AWS CDK, and Terragrunt
  - **Cloud providers:** AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and private cloud environments
  - **Version control systems:** GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps
  - **Security and monitoring:** Open Policy Agent, Datadog, Infracost, and more

For a full list of integrations, visit [Spacelift Integrations](https://spacelift.io/integrations).

- Is Spacelift secure for enterprise use?





Yes. Spacelift supports enterprise security controls, including SAML 2.0 SSO, fine-grained RBAC, audit trails, and encryption in transit and at rest. You can run jobs on private workers so secrets and execution stay in your environment. For current practices and compliance details, visit [Spacelift Security](https://spacelift.io/security).

- Who uses Spacelift?





Spacelift is used by DevOps, platform, and SRE teams at startups and global enterprises to standardize infrastructure as code (IaC) delivery, security, and governance. Customers span fintech, e-commerce, mobility, media, and SaaS.

- How can I try or get started with Spacelift?





Getting started with Spacelift is easy. You can sign up for a [free trial](https://spacelift.io/free-trial) to explore its features, or [schedule a demo](https://spacelift.io/schedule-demo) with our team for a personalized walkthrough.



Our [documentation](https://docs.spacelift.io/) provides detailed guides to help you set up and configure Spacelift for your workflow. Additionally, we offer a [Terraform starter repository](https://github.com/spacelift-io/terraform-starter) on GitHub to help users quickly integrate Spacelift into their IaC pipelines.



If you have specific questions or need assistance, our [sales team](https://spacelift.io/contact) is available to help.
